about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Swedish Cardamom Oat Porridge
recipes.summary: Creamy milk oats scented with cardamom, finished with butter and honey.
steps: Bring the oats, milk, salt and cardamom to a gentle simmer in a saucepan, stirring often until bubbling.
Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Stir through the butter, spoon into bowls and drizzle with honey.
notes: Use oat milk for a dairy-free version.
Oats can contain traces of gluten.

recipes.title: Finnish Oven Pancake Pannukakku
recipes.summary: A puffed, custardy oven pancake baked in butter, cut into wedges.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and put the butter in a 25 cm baking dish until melted.
Whisk the eggs, milk, flour, sugar and salt until smooth.
Pour the batter into the hot dish and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden.
Cut into wedges and serve straight away.
notes: Food safety: bake until the centre is fully set with no wet egg.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Estonian Rye Bread with Egg and Chive Butter
recipes.summary: Dense rye bread spread with soft chive butter and topped with sliced boiled egg.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are firm, then cool, peel and slice.
Mash the butter with the chives and salt until combined.
Spread the chive butter over the rye bread and top with the egg.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the yolks are firm and keep leftovers chilled for up to 2 days.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Norwegian Creamed Cabbage
recipes.summary: Soft cabbage in a light white sauce with nutmeg, a traditional side for sausages and meatballs.
steps: Simmer the cabbage in salted water for 8 minutes until tender, then drain well.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk and simmer for 4 minutes until thickened, then season with nutmeg and salt.
Fold the cabbage through the sauce and heat for 2 minutes until hot.
notes: Use a dairy-free spread and oat milk to make it dairy-free.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Estonian Rosolje Beetroot and Potato Salad
recipes.summary: A ruby salad of beetroot, potato, apple, pickles and egg in a sour cream dressing.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes until tender, then cool and dice.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are firm, then cool, peel and chop.
Mix the sour cream, mustard and salt together.
Fold the potato, beetroot, apple, pickles and egg through the dressing.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the yolks are firm and keep the salad chilled, eating within 2 days.
Beetroot will tint everything pink.

recipes.title: Portuguese Chickpea and Spinach Soup
recipes.summary: A hearty cumin and paprika chickpea soup finished with wilted spinach.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until the flavours meld.
Stir in the spinach for 2 minutes until wilted, then add the vinegar.
notes: Mash a few chickpeas against the pot to thicken the soup.
Check the stock label for gluten.

recipes.title: Spanish Garlic Soup with Poached Egg
recipes.summary: Castilian sopa de ajo: golden garlic, paprika and bread in broth with a poached egg.
steps: Fry the garlic in the oil for 1 minute until golden, then add the bread and cook for 3 minutes until crisp.
Stir in the paprika, then the stock, and simmer for 10 minutes until the bread softens.
Crack the eggs into the soup and poach for 3 minutes until the whites are fully set.
Ladle into bowls with one egg each.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Galician Bean and Greens Broth
recipes.summary: A rustic broth of white beans, potato, cabbage and smoky bacon.
steps: Cook the bacon in the oil for 5 minutes until browned, then add the onion for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the potato, paprika and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is tender.
Add the beans and cabbage and cook for 8 minutes until the cabbage is soft.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until browned and the soup until steaming, at least 75°C, and eat within 3 days.
Check the stock label for gluten.

recipes.title: Salmorejo Cordoban Tomato Soup
recipes.summary: A thick, chilled Andalusian tomato and bread soup topped with egg.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are firm, then cool, peel and chop.
Blend the tomatoes, bread, garlic, vinegar and salt until smooth.
With the blender running, pour in the oil until the soup is thick and creamy.
Chill, then serve topped with the chopped egg.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the yolks are firm and keep the soup chilled, eating within 2 days.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Spanish Russian Potato Salad Ensaladilla Rusa
recipes.summary: Potato, carrot, peas, tuna and egg bound with mayonnaise, a staple tapas plate.
steps: Boil the potato and carrot for 12 minutes until just tender, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, then drain and cool.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are firm, then cool, peel and chop.
Fold the vegetables, tuna, egg, mayonnaise, vinegar and salt together until coated.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the yolks are firm and keep the salad chilled, eating within 2 days.
Contains fish and egg.

recipes.title: Catalan Tomato Bread Pa amb Tomaquet
recipes.summary: Toasted bread rubbed with garlic and ripe tomato, finished with olive oil.
steps: Toast the bread under a hot grill for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Rub each slice with the garlic, then with the cut tomato until the flesh soaks in.
Drizzle with the oil and sprinkle with the salt.
notes: Use very ripe tomatoes for the best flavour.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Uzbek Achichuk Tomato and Onion Salad
recipes.summary: Paper-thin tomato and red onion with chilli and coriander, served with plov and kebabs.
steps: Arrange the tomato and onion in overlapping layers on a plate.
Scatter over the chilli and coriander.
Sprinkle with the vinegar and salt and toss gently until coated, just before serving.
notes: Soak the sliced onion in cold water for a milder bite.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Georgian Cucumber and Walnut Salad
recipes.summary: Crisp cucumber with ground walnuts, garlic and coriander in a light vinegar dressing.
steps: Mix the walnuts, garlic, vinegar, oil and salt into a rough paste.
Toss the cucumber and coriander with the paste until coated.
Serve straight away so the cucumber stays crisp.
notes: Contains tree nuts.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Armenian Herb and Radish Salad
recipes.summary: A bright pile of parsley, mint, radish and tomato with lemon and olive oil.
steps: Combine the parsley, mint, radish, tomato and spring onions in a bowl.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, sumac and salt together.
Toss the dressing through the salad until every leaf is glossy, just before serving.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Azerbaijani Grilled Eggplant and Tomato Salad
recipes.summary: Smoky roasted eggplant with tomato, capsicum, garlic and coriander.
steps: Roast the whole eggplants at 220°C for 40 minutes until collapsed and charred, then peel and chop the flesh.
Mix the eggplant with the tomato, capsicum, onion, garlic and coriander.
Dress with the oil, vinegar and salt.
notes: Drain the eggplant flesh well so the salad is not watery.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Uzbek Spiced Carrot Salad
recipes.summary: Shredded carrot with garlic, coriander seed and chilli under hot oil.
steps: Mix the carrot, garlic, coriander, chilli flakes, sugar, vinegar and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Heat the oil for 2 minutes until shimmering, then pour it over the carrot.
Stir well and serve warm or chilled.
notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Uzbek Lagman Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: Beef, capsicum and noodles in a tomato-rich broth, a Central Asian one-pot.

items: 300 g beef rump, cut in thin strips

steps: Brown the beef in the oil for 4 minutes until coloured, then add the onion, carrot and capsicum for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the garlic, tomato paste and cumin for 1 minute, then add the stock.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the noodles and cook for 5 minutes until tender, then scatter with coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until no pink remains and the soup reaches 75°C; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Peruvian Choclo con Queso
recipes.summary: Sweet corn on the cob served with salty feta, as sold on Andean street corners.
steps: Boil the corn in water for 12 minutes until the kernels are tender.
Drain and let the cobs steam dry for 1 minute.
Serve each cob with a slab of feta.
notes: Traditional queso fresco can replace the feta.
Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Ecuadorian Llapingachos Cheesy Potato Patties
recipes.summary: Mashed potato patties stuffed with melting cheese and pan-fried until golden.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until soft, drain and mash with the salt.
Cook the onion in the butter for 5 minutes until soft and mix into the potato.
Shape into 8 balls, press a pinch of mozzarella into each and flatten into patties.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
notes: Serve with a fried egg or peanut sauce.
Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Bolivian Quinoa Vegetable Soup
recipes.summary: A warming Andean soup of quinoa, potato, carrot and cumin.
steps: Cook the onion and carrot in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the potato, quinoa, cumin and stock and simmer for 20 minutes until the quinoa is tender and the potato soft.
Stir through the coriander and serve.
notes: Rinse the quinoa well to remove any bitterness.
Naturally vegan; check the stock for gluten.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Lomi Lomi Tomato Salad
recipes.summary: Juicy tomato massaged with sweet onion, spring onion and lemon, a luau side.
steps: Combine the tomato, onion and spring onions in a bowl.
Add the lemon juice, sesame oil and salt.
Massage gently with your fingers until the tomato releases its juices.
notes: Traditionally served with salmon or pork.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Finnish Creamy Mushroom Salad
recipes.summary: Blanched button mushrooms in a cream and vinegar dressing with onion and chives.
steps: Blanch the mushrooms in boiling water for 3 minutes until just tender, then drain and cool.
Whisk the cream, vinegar and salt together until slightly thickened.
Fold through the mushrooms, onion and chives until coated.
notes: Serve on rye bread or beside roast meats.
Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Pineapple Coleslaw
recipes.summary: Crunchy cabbage and carrot with sweet pineapple in a tangy creamy dressing.
steps: Combine the cabbage, carrot, pineapple and spring onions in a bowl.
Whisk the mayonnaise and vinegar together.
Toss through the slaw until evenly coated.
notes: Contains egg.
Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Latvian Cabbage and Potato Soup
recipes.summary: A simple, homely soup of cabbage, potato and carrot finished with sour cream and dill.
steps: Cook the onion and carrot in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the cabbage, potato, stock and bay leaf and simmer for 20 minutes until the potato is tender.
Ladle into bowls and top with the sour cream and dill.
notes: Remove the bay leaf before serving.
Check the stock label for gluten.
